author: Camilla Lo Giudice

steps.title: Create Seasonal Technologies and Commodities
steps.instruction: Define the seasonal phases for crop-land in the MUIO interface.

substeps.instruction: Navigate to Configure the model --> Technologies and add 'Season1' (Growing season) and 'Season2' (Harvesting season).
Navigate to Configure the model --> Commodities and add 'S1' and 'S2'.
Update the model.

steps.title: Increase Modes of Operation
steps.instruction: Configure the modes of operation to characterize different water cycles for each season.

substeps.instruction: Navigate to Configure the model --> Model data --> Modes of operation and increase the number of modes (e.g., two modes for two seasons).
Update the model.

steps.title: Set Seasonal Input Activity Ratios
steps.instruction: Assign input activity ratios for crop-land commodities S1 and S2 based on the mode of operation.

substeps.instruction: Navigate to Configure the model --> Technologies -> Input Activity Ratio.
In Data entry --> Input activity ratio, set the value to 1 for MoO 1 if the commodity is S1, and 1 for MoO 2 if the commodity is S2.

steps.title: Configure Capacity Factors
steps.instruction: Set capacity factors to ensure seasonal technologies only operate during their corresponding time-slices.

substeps.instruction: Define the temporal resolution using 'Time-Slices' and 'Year-Split'.

Assign a capacity factor of 1 for the time slice representing the season and 0 for all other time slices (e.g., for 6 time-slices S11, S12, S13, S21, S22, S23, the factor is 1 for S1x in Season 1 and 1 for S2x in Season 2).

steps.title: Set Seasonal Output Activity Ratios
steps.instruction: Configure output activity ratios for seasonal technologies to maintain water balance and land allocation.

substeps.instruction: Navigate to Configure the model --> Technologies --> Output Activity Ratio for Season1 and Season2.
In Data entry --> Output activity ratio, set the value to 1 only for the corresponding seasonal mode (e.g., Season 1 = 1 for MoO 1; Season 2 = 1 for MoO 2).

steps.title: Ensure Harvested Area Consistency
steps.instruction: Prevent land from being unallocated in non-harvest seasons by aligning output activity ratios.

substeps.instruction: Navigate to Data entry --> Output Activity Ratio.
Paste the same values from MoO 1 into MoO 2 and save data.

steps.title: Configure Land Technology Parameters
steps.instruction: Set operational and cost parameters to ensure consistency between capacity and activity.

substeps.instruction: Set operational life to 1 year for all croplands.
Set capital costs to zero.
Calibrate using activity instead of capacity: set a lower and upper annual activity limit (upper limit/max capacity can be 1% higher than lower limit).
Set maximum capacity equal to the upper activity limit.
Assign identical values for both modes of operation for 'Technology Activity Decrease By Mode Limit' and 'Technology Activity Increase By Mode Limit'.
Assign Fixed and Variable costs for both modes.

steps.title: Configure Crop Demand
steps.instruction: Split the annual crop demand across the model's year split using specified demand profiles.

substeps.instruction: Use the 'Specified Annual Demand' parameter for total yearly demand.
Use the 'Specified Demand Profile' parameter to input the annual fraction of commodity demand required in each time slice, using the same value as the year-split.

steps.title: Enter Water Input and Output Ratios
steps.instruction: Input the specific activity ratios for precipitation and water outputs.

substeps.instruction: Enter the input activity ratio for crops (precipitation), ensuring MoO 1 represents Season 1 and MoO 2 represents Season 2.
Enter the output activity ratios for water (evapotranspiration, groundwater, and run-off water).

steps.title: Verify Results
steps.instruction: Check the model output to ensure harvested area is consistent across seasons.

substeps.instruction: Filter results by 'Rate Of Activity' for croplands and by modes of operation (Mo Id).
